3.name: Vitality of the Tree
3.notes: When you activate your Rage, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Barbarian level. In addition, at the start of each of your turns while your Rage is active, you can choose another creature within 10 feet of you to gain Temporary Hit Points equal to the total of a number of d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus. Any of these Temporary Hit Points that remain when your Rage ends are lost.

6.name: Branches of the Tree
6.notes: While your Rage is active, when a creature you can see starts its turn within 30 feet of you, you can use your Reaction to summon spectral branches of the World Tree around it. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + your Strength modifier + your Proficiency Bonus) or be teleported to an unoccupied space you can see within 5 feet of you or the nearest unoccupied space you can see. After the teleport, you can reduce the target's Speed to 0 until the end of the current turn.

10.name: Battering Roots
10.notes: During your turn, your reach increases by 10 feet when you make attacks with a Melee weapon that has the Heavy or Versatile property, as tendrils of the World Tree extend from you. When you hit a creature with such a weapon on your turn, you can activate the Push or Topple mastery property in addition to a different mastery property you are already using with that weapon.

14.name: Travel Along the Tree
14.notes: When you activate your Rage and as a Bonus Action while your Rage is active, you can teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. In addition, once per Rage, you can increase the teleport range to 150 feet and bring up to six willing creatures within 10 feet of you. Each chosen creature teleports to an unoccupied space of your choice within 10 feet of your destination space.
